acceptance_check.source_claim_and_assumptions: Section4.3 Gluing3 p35 prescribes k+1 real pulses on a charged background and invokes a mass-sphere Borsuk-Ulam argument to eliminate k transverse scalar jets. The source uses complex scalar jets; Section4.2 correctly uses2k+1 real parameters.
acceptance_check.independent_argument: Primary checked Eq2.13 and Maxwell's equation: with Omega?=1, real phi and fixed Q, Z=D_u(r phi) satisfies Z_v=(-m/(2r?)+Q?/(4r?))phi-i eQ phi/(4r). For k=1 take the allowed Qf=Rf=Mf=M>0 and two separated ordered nonnegative pulses. In the claimed r>0,ru<0 class, rv(1)=0 gives rv>=0,r<=M and varpi<=M. H=2m/r-M?/r? obeys H_v=4r(-ru)|phi_v|?+(3M?-2mr)rv/r?, with 3M?-2mr>=2M?. If both amplitudes are nonzero the second pulse forces rv>0 in the gap, so the weighted moments satisfy K1/J1<K2/J2. Vanishing imaginary endpoint jet forces alpha1 J1=-alpha2 J2 and then the real jet is nonzero. One nonzero pulse already has nonzero imaginary jet, while zero amplitudes fail the positive mass increment. Thus the prescribed procedure fails for these allowed profiles, beyond a parameter-count heuristic.
acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_core_dependency: The obstruction invalidates the printed subsidiary interior-gluing construction supporting Theorems2C/2C' and Corollaries2-3. It is not a nonexistence proof for2C with another pulse family and does not refute the principal Theorem1, whose2A/2B construction uses the correct complex dimension. Gauge changes cannot make a nonzero endpoint jet vanish when phi=0.
acceptance_check.repair_scope: Using2k+1 pulses is a candidate repair requiring a smooth even mass-level radial graph, positive radial derivative, uniform estimates and an odd full complex jet map. Those requirements are not certified merely by the dimension count.
